rule: PREREG 5 as amended (AMENDMENTS A2.2): default D = t2_best5 SELECTED (snapshot), the same for both variants; a challenger qualifies iff cons_mean_AUC >= cons_mean_AUC(D) + 0.01 (exact floats) AND own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 4 of its 5 official runs; pick the qualifying one with the highest cons_mean_AUC (ties: lower population variance, lower cons_mean MPPE, job name). Variant B (reference R/F/C/G, all candidates incl. G2 input) is BINDING; variant A (reference R/F/C, no G2-input job) is reported only. CLOSEST run = the run of the pick whose variant-B consensus AUC is closest to its 5-run variant-B mean (ties: lower run).
